create_staircase_model: create a StaircaseModel with args containing vocab_sz, hid_sz, mem_sz, nlayers, and fix_staircase_size_forward
build_staircase_attention: build a StaircaseSeqAttention module that performs sequential self-attention with relative position embeddings
build_transformer_mod: build a TransformerMod with multiple TransformerModLayer blocks using staircase attention
initialize_hid_cache: initialize a hidden state cache for the staircase model with a given batch size
run_staircase_forward: run the staircase model forward pass with input tokens and previous hidden states
